llm.summary: This is a workflow/documentation helper with no executable code or persistence, though its broad auto-activation wording may cause it to appear for unrelated requests.

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly favors local-hardware-friendly outputs such as scripts, templates, checklists, analysis, and CPU-safe workflows, which is proportionate to the stated productivity/security-workflow purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No custom installer, package manager command, post-install hook, or executable setup mechanism was present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructions are coherent with the stated workflow-helper purpose, but the description, keywords, examples, and implicit invocation setting are broad enough that the skill could be selected outside a clearly intentional SkillScan workflow request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background process, privilege escalation, broad local indexing, profile/session access, or credential storage behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact's stated purpose is to help with SkillScan-style workflow planning, hardening checklists, analysis, and implementation support; the inspected files contain only markdown and YAML guidance, with no scripts, commands, credential handling, destructive actions, or data exfiltration behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that this skill may activate for broad security or productivity phrasing, not only explicit SkillScan workflow requests. It appears safe as a documentation/workflow helper, but users who prefer precise routing should invoke it explicitly or narrow its trigger terms.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The scanner's broad-trigger concern is supported by artifact text: common keywords such as security, every, must, pass, before, and allow_implicit_invocation could cause accidental activation. I downgraded this to guidance rather than Review because the skill contains no executable code, sensitive data access, persistence, or privileged mutation authority.
